data.cultural_impact: The name "Prakash" refers to the manifestation of divine powers that illuminate from within and emanate outwardly, just as the sun sheds light on the world. It is a powerful Sanskrit name that has been traditionally associated with the Sun God.
data.spiritual_significance: According to Hindu beliefs, the name "Prakash" signifies the inner light of awareness, wisdom, and knowledge that awakens the individual to their true spiritual nature. It is a divine name that bestows grace and blessings from the Sun God, symbolizing enlightenment, illumination, and the ultimate realization of truth.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Prakash was a famous Hindu king in the 13th century. The name प्रकाश carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: King of the Chalukya dynasty in Karnataka, India
